'''Gaffer Gamgee An Entire Legion of My Finest Hunters''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaffer Gamgee]]
* '''Published:''' 29 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile Gamgee DS 2003 AnEntire.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

An updated version of my Court of the Vile Gangster deck using the new Virtual Set 6!

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Wow...there are so many great Virtual Set 6 cards (especially effects)! Basicly, I'm thinking that with this deck, you should pull Boba Fett (V) using the audience chamber at the start of the game. He has a low enough deploy that you can pull him on your first turn. You can then slap a bounty (or Hutt Bounty) on whoever the light side deploys. I am considering adding another bounty to the deck.

One of the things that was killing this deck was reacting away from battle. My friend kept doing this with his deck. Ability, ability, ability (V) should put a stop to that.

Let me know what else I should do with this deck. Also if you can spare a Jodo Kast or Mara Jade please e-mail me: sanders@uclink.berkeley.edu or AIM: NadoSteve

Thanks!
